notes: An open-wheeler needs much less adjusting than a road car, because its
unwrap is already organised the way a livery thinks: each flank separate,
generous sponsor space, nothing mirrored. The portable design lands the
number and the team name on the same panel here, left_mid, where they stack
without colliding — so the only change is to give the number more of it.
The driver strip stays. On this car it targets left_mid_lower_2, which is
small but flat and sits where a real F4 carries the driver's name.
